cards.front: Recall a key point about The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram
cards.back: The HR diagram plots luminosity (vertical axis, increasing upward) against temperature/spectral class (horizontal axis, decreasing left to right)

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram
cards.back: The main sequence runs diagonally from top-left (hot, luminous) to bottom-right (cool, dim)

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram
cards.back: Red giants appear in the upper-right: cool but very luminous due to large size

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram
cards.back: White dwarfs appear in the lower-left: hot but dim due to small size

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram
cards.back: Supergiants span the top of the diagram across all spectral types

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram
cards.back: The instability strip (between main sequence and giants) contains variable stars like Cepheids
